title: zanthoxylum syncarpum
intro: Zanthoxylum syncarpum, commonly known as the Philippine pepper tree, is a type of flowering plant in the Rutaceae family, native to the Philippines. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum syncarpum include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and cough, and as an anti-inflammatory agent, reducing pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
